text:
Jordan P: New dev here trying the Node quickstart. First run returned text (I thought I was in), then subsequent calls immediately fail with 402 billing_required. Weird. Anyone seen this?
Nina S: Which key are you using? Workspace key or your personal dev key?
Jordan P: Using the key in the workspace settings. I followed the "node quickstart" sample exactly. First run (after restart) returned \"Hello\" and then the next request got 402.
Jordan P: Node snippet I used:
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const r = await client.generate({ model: 'gpt-redwood-3', input: 'hi' });
console.log(r.output);
```
Jordan P: Error payload from SDK on failure:
```
Error: Request failed (402) - billing.required
  at Redwood.request (/usr/src/app/node_modules/@redwood/inference/lib/index.js:120:15)
  at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues.js:93:5)
```
Eli M: SDK-bot, does our SDK do any retry/backoff that could explain the working first call then a fail?
SDK-bot: Node SDK performs one automatic retry for 5xx/429 by default. 402 is not retried. No long-running cache.
Nina S: Could your first successful call have been routed to hosted demo environment with a free sandbox key? Sometimes new accounts get a short-lived sandbox key during onboarding that expires after first call.
Jordan P: Huh - the console shows API key "workspace: ws_jordan_dev" and it looked active.
billing-bot: Billing status for ws_jordan_dev: payment_method=unset, trial_credits=0, api_access=false, last_action=1763099000.
Eli M: That explains it. The UI currently displays an "API key created" banner immediately but the workspace activation (which sets api_access=true) is a separate step. If the sample app happened to hit a cached dev endpoint before activation it would succeed once.
Jordan P: OK that matches timeline. Suggestion: we should update the quickstart to show the console step "Enable billing / enable API access" and include the specific error message text to look for (billing.required).
Nina S: Filing a docs PR and a small SDK change: make the Node SDK error message include the raw body and the workspace id when available so support can triage faster.
Eli M: Also adding a one-line note in the onboarding flow: "If your first call returns content but subsequent calls error with billing.required, check workspace billing and API access flag."
Jordan P: Thanks! After adding a payment method and turning on API access the quickstart now consistently returns 200s. First working call confirmed. :white_check_mark:
Nina S: Nice. We'll also add a health check endpoint to the quickstart script that fails loudly if 4xx/402 so new devs don't assume success on a single run.
Jordan P: Appreciate the fast help, saved my afternoon :)
